optimized_sql:
WITH
filtered_dates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d.d_date_sk, d.d_date
    FROM date_dim AS d
    WHERE d.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
),
customer_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name
    FROM customer AS c
),
store_customers AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, d.d_date
    FROM store_sales AS ss
    JOIN filtered_dates AS d
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_rows AS c
        ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
),
catalog_customers AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, d.d_date
    FROM catalog_sales AS cs
    JOIN filtered_dates AS d
        ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_rows AS c
        ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
),
web_customers AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, d.d_date
    FROM web_sales AS ws
    JOIN filtered_dates AS d
        ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_rows AS c
        ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
)
SELECT count(*)
FROM (
    SELECT s.c_last_name, s.c_first_name, s.d_date
    FROM store_customers AS s
    JOIN catalog_customers AS ca
        ON s.c_last_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ca.c_last_name
       AND s.c_first_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ca.c_first_name
       AND s.d_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ca.d_date
    JOIN web_customers AS w
        ON s.c_last_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM w.c_last_name
       AND s.c_first_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM w.c_first_name
       AND s.d_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM w.d_date
) AS hot_cust
LIMIT 100
